page.layout: One page of text, one column. Above the text, a centred title block of several lines in capitals and roman type. Printed page number top right. Signature at foot left. No running head, no notes in the margins.

main_text.head: ISAACI CASAVBONI IN THEOPHRASTI CHA-racteres Ethicos Prolegomena.
main_text.p: NScRIPTIO huius libelli, quæ in omnibus codicibus hæc est, Θεοφράστε[?] Ηθικοὶ χαρακτῆρες, tribus verbis triadeclarat: auctore scripti istius: materiam eius, siue subiectum: formam siue tractandi modum: de quibus omnibus aliquid est nobis hoc loco dicendum. Auctorem esse verè aureoli libelli istius Theophrastum Eresium, magnum illum maximi Aristotelis discipulum, verum censeo. Nam & Diogenes Laertius inter Theophrasti librorum indices, Ηθικὸς χαρακτῆρας[?] recensèt: & Suidas qui pauciffimos eius philosophi libros commemorat, huius tamen meminit: quod etiam indicio esse posfit, in pretio olim apud doctos Theophrasti hoc opus fuisse. Deinde quum certum omnino sit, prodiisse hæc ex eruditissimi & elegantissimi alicuius viri officina, qui Athenis eo ipso tempore quo claruit Theophrastus, & vixerit (id quod non vno loco annotatum à nobis demonstratúmque est) & scripserit, non video quid cauffæ esse queat, cur aut

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Scriptio" as "NScRIPTIO" with small capitals as printed. Greek words in the first and second lines are marked [?] where the scan is hard to read; the accents may not be exact. The top right "83" is the printed page number. The ornamental headpiece and the circular stamp-like mark on the right of the title are not printed text and are left out.
